# MariaDB Foundation — `.github`

This repository hosts community health files for the MariaDB Foundation GitHub organization, along with official brand assets for external use.

## Logo & Branding

The MariaDB Foundation logo is provided in [`assets/logos`](./assets/logos), available in the following formats:

- **SVG** (`assets/logos/svg`) — scalable, recommended for web use
- **PNG** (`assets/logos/png`) — for quick embeds and use cases where SVG isn't supported

These formats cover the vast majority of use cases, including web embeds, print, and social previews.

### License

The logo is available for use under the [Creative Commons CC-BY-SA 4.0 license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/).

Please attribute to **MariaDB Foundation** when using the logo.

### Usage Guidelines

- These marks identify the **MariaDB Foundation**. You may use them to refer to the Foundation and its activities — for example, to link to us, to indicate membership or sponsorship, or in articles, talks, and presentations about the Foundation.
- Use the files as provided. Don't alter the proportions, colours, or elements. Where you need a single-colour or reversed version for dark backgrounds, use the variants we supply rather than recolouring it yourself.
- Don't use the logo to suggest that the Foundation endorses, sponsors, or is affiliated with your product, project, or organisation unless we have agreed to that.
- Don't use it to refer to other MariaDB or non-MariaDB entities, and don't incorporate it into your own logo, product name, or branding.
- Give it clear space; don't lock it up with other marks so they read as one combined mark.

### Source Files

Original Adobe Illustrator (`.ai`) source files are not included in this repository.

If you require the source files — for example, for custom resizing, color adjustments, or print production — please contact the MariaDB Foundation at **foundation@mariadb.org** with details on your intended use.

### Questions

For anything not covered here, or for clarification on a specific use case, please reach out to the MariaDB Foundation at **foundation@mariadb.org**.

## Events - [`Upcoming ServerFests and Conferences`](https://mariadb.org/events/#upcoming) - [`Meetup`](https://www.meetup.com/pro/anna-widenius/) ## Projects - [`MariaDB Server`](https://github.com/MariaDB/server) - One of the world’s most popular open source relational databases - [`The feedback plugin`](https://github.com/MariaDB/feedback-plugin-backend) - This is an important tool as it gives more transparency towards the current use-cases and user configurations. It helps with usage statistics and functionality prioritisation. It is disabled by default and it does not collect any personal data. [`Enable it`](https://mariadb.com/kb/en/feedback-plugin/#enabling-the-plugin) to help shape MariaDB's future. You can [`check it out here`](https://mariadb.org/feedback-plugin/) - [`Buildbot`](https://github.com/MariaDB/buildbot) - MariaDB's continuous integration testing platform, based on the Buildbot.net open-source testing framework. Check it out [`here`](https://buildbot.mariadb.org/#/) - [`Test Automation Framework (TAF)`](https://github.com/MariaDB/TAF) - A deterministic, extensible test automation framework written in Perl - [`Jupyter Kernel`](https://github.com/MariaDB/mariadb_kernel) - An Open Source kernel for Jupyter which enables users to run MariaDB in a Jupyter notebook ## Projects related to MariaDB Server - [`MariaDB ColumnStore`](https://github.com/mariadb-corporation/mariadb-columnstore-engine) - Extends the Enterprise Server with distributed, columnar storage - [`MariaDB Galera Cluster`](https://github.com/codership/galera) - An open source active-active, multimaster synchronous replication solution - [`File a bug or feature request`](https://mariadb.com/kb/en/reporting-bugs/) - [`Sponsorships`](https://mariadb.org/donate/) ### Main Contributors - [`MariaDB Foundation`](https://mariadb.org/about/#about-mariadb-foundation) -
